event.title: Getting Started with Genealogy – AM
event.description:
Join us for an enlightening 20-minute presentation on “Getting Started with Genealogy,” followed by a 10-minute Q&A session, where your curiosity about tracing your family’s roots can be explored and answered. This engaging session will guide both beginners and those with some experience through the fascinating world of genealogy research.

In this presentation, we will cover the essential steps on how to embark on your genealogy journey, unraveling the secrets of your family’s past. We will share proven methods for genealogy research, including the use of online databases, traditional archival work, and more. Along with these, we’ll provide key tips to enhance your research, making your exploration more efficient and rewarding.

The presentation is offered Tuesday through Friday, at 11:00 AM and 2:00 PM in the Center for Family History Conference room. Don’t miss this opportunity to delve into your family’s history, connect with your ancestors, and discover stories that have shaped who you are today.

Come, uncover your roots, and be a part of this thrilling journey! See you there!

This class is included with your museum admission ticket.

Join us for an enlightening 20-minute presentation on “Getting Started with Genealogy,” followed by a 10-minute Q&A session, where your curiosity about tracing your family’s roots can be explored and answered. This engaging session will guide both beginners and those with some experience through the fascinating world of genealogy research.

In this presentation, we will cover the essential steps on how to embark on your genealogy journey, unraveling the secrets of your family’s past. We will share proven methods for genealogy research, including the use of online databases, traditional archival work, and more. Along with these, we’ll provide key tips to enhance your research, making your exploration more efficient and rewarding.

The presentation is offered Tuesday through Friday, at 11:00 AM and 2:00 PM in the Center for Family History Conference room. Don’t miss this opportunity to delve into your family’s history, connect with your ancestors, and discover stories that have shaped who you are today.

Come, uncover your roots, and be a part of this thrilling journey! See you there!

This class is included with your museum admission ticket.

Join us for an enlightening 20-minute presentation on “Getting Started with Genealogy,” followed by a 10-minute Q&A session, where your curiosity about tracing your family’s roots can be explored and answered. This engaging session will guide both beginners and those with some experience through the fascinating world of genealogy research.

In this presentation, we will cover the essential steps on how to embark on your genealogy journey, unraveling the secrets of your family’s past. We will share proven methods for genealogy research, including the use of online databases, traditional archival work, and more. Along with these, we’ll provide key tips to enhance your research, making your exploration more efficient and rewarding.

The presentation is offered Tuesday through Friday, at 11:00 AM and 2:00 PM in the Center for Family History Conference room. Don’t miss this opportunity to delve into your family’s history, connect with your ancestors, and discover stories that have shaped who you are today.

Come, uncover your roots, and be a part of this thrilling journey! See you there!

This class is included with your museum admission ticket.

Join us for an enlightening 20-minute presentation on “Getting Started with Genealogy,” followed by a 10-minute Q&A session, where your curiosity about tracing your family’s roots can be explored and answered. This engaging session will guide both beginners and those with some experience through the fascinating world of genealogy research.

In this presentation, we will cover the essential steps on how to embark on your genealogy journey, unraveling the secrets of your family’s past. We will share proven methods for genealogy research, including the use of online databases, traditional archival work, and more. Along with these, we’ll provide key tips to enhance your research, making your exploration more efficient and rewarding.

The presentation is offered Tuesday through Friday, at 11:00 AM and 2:00 PM in the Center for Family History Conference room. Don’t miss this opportunity to delve into your family’s history, connect with your ancestors, and discover stories that have shaped who you are today.

Come, uncover your roots, and be a part of this thrilling journey! See you there!

This class is included with your museum admission ticket.

Join us for an enlightening 20-minute presentation on “Getting Started with Genealogy,” followed by a 10-minute Q&A session, where your curiosity about tracing your family’s roots can be explored and answered. This engaging session will guide both beginners and those with some experience through the fascinating world of genealogy research.

In this presentation, we will cover the essential steps on how to embark on your genealogy journey, unraveling the secrets of your family’s past. We will share proven methods for genealogy research, including the use of online databases, traditional archival work, and more. Along with these, we’ll provide key tips to enhance your research, making your exploration more efficient and rewarding.

The presentation is offered Tuesday through Friday, at 11:00 AM and 2:00 PM in the Center for Family History Conference room. Don’t miss this opportunity to delve into your family’s history, connect with your ancestors, and discover stories that have shaped who you are today.

Come, uncover your roots, and be a part of this thrilling journey! See you there!

This class is included with your museum admission ticket.

“Jazz It Up” with dinner, drinks and live music at the Sarto bar or in the dining room, as local trios perform hot Jazz from 6:30-8:30pm weekly on Saturdays.

Heading to a show downtown? Be sure to stop by Sarto after the show and enjoy music, dessert or bar snacks and a late-night libation.

event.title: Brunch with Sarto
event.description:
Enjoy a full brunch menu packed with playful, elevated dishes. Offering appetizers like our “Italian Pop-Tart” (Caprese-style in puff pastry), Italian Poutine loaded with short rib and fontina cheese sauce, and the crowd-favorite Avocado Toast on toasted focaccia.

For entrées, the culinary team at Sarto has created modern Italian brunch offerings such as Eggs in Purgatory (poached eggs in fra diavolo sauce with grated gran padano and aleppo pepper, served with focaccia), the Nutella Crespella with strawberries and vanilla soil, and savory stars like the Steak Hash.

Pair it all with our specialty brunch cocktail menu, featuring Bottomless Mimosas, Bottomless Bellinis, and more!

Celebrate Sunday Funday with Brunch at Sarto, for a culinary brunch experience unlike any other in Providence!

event.title: Jazz It Up with Sarto
event.description:
“Jazz It Up” with dinner, drinks and live music at the Sarto bar or in the dining room, as local trios perform hot Jazz from 6:30-8:30pm weekly on Saturdays.

Heading to a show downtown? Be sure to stop by Sarto after the show and enjoy music, dessert or bar snacks and a late-night libation.

Out with a group? Perfect! Plan ahead and make online reservations for table service for you and your friends, so everyone has a seat during Jazz it up with Sarto!

event.title: Brunch with Sarto
event.description:
Enjoy a full brunch menu packed with playful, elevated dishes. Offering appetizers like our “Italian Pop-Tart” (Caprese-style in puff pastry), Italian Poutine loaded with short rib and fontina cheese sauce, and the crowd-favorite Avocado Toast on toasted focaccia.

For entrées, the culinary team at Sarto has created modern Italian brunch offerings such as Eggs in Purgatory (poached eggs in fra diavolo sauce with grated gran padano and aleppo pepper, served with focaccia), the Nutella Crespella with strawberries and vanilla soil, and savory stars like the Steak Hash.

Pair it all with our specialty brunch cocktail menu, featuring Bottomless Mimosas, Bottomless Bellinis, and more!

Celebrate Sunday Funday with Brunch at Sarto, for a culinary brunch experience unlike any other in Providence!

event.title: Jazz It Up with Sarto
event.description:
“Jazz It Up” with dinner, drinks and live music at the Sarto bar or in the dining room, as local trios perform hot Jazz from 6:30-8:30pm weekly on Saturdays.

Heading to a show downtown? Be sure to stop by Sarto after the show and enjoy music, dessert or bar snacks and a late-night libation.

Out with a group? Perfect! Plan ahead and make online reservations for table service for you and your friends, so everyone has a seat during Jazz it up with Sarto!

event.title: Brunch with Sarto
event.description:
Enjoy a full brunch menu packed with playful, elevated dishes. Offering appetizers like our “Italian Pop-Tart” (Caprese-style in puff pastry), Italian Poutine loaded with short rib and fontina cheese sauce, and the crowd-favorite Avocado Toast on toasted focaccia.

For entrées, the culinary team at Sarto has created modern Italian brunch offerings such as Eggs in Purgatory (poached eggs in fra diavolo sauce with grated gran padano and aleppo pepper, served with focaccia), the Nutella Crespella with strawberries and vanilla soil, and savory stars like the Steak Hash.

Pair it all with our specialty brunch cocktail menu, featuring Bottomless Mimosas, Bottomless Bellinis, and more!

Celebrate Sunday Funday with Brunch at Sarto, for a culinary brunch experience unlike any other in Providence!

event.title: Jazz It Up with Sarto
event.description:
“Jazz It Up” with dinner, drinks and live music at the Sarto bar or in the dining room, as local trios perform hot Jazz from 6:30-8:30pm weekly on Saturdays.

Heading to a show downtown? Be sure to stop by Sarto after the show and enjoy music, dessert or bar snacks and a late-night libation.

Out with a group? Perfect! Plan ahead and make online reservations for table service for you and your friends, so everyone has a seat during Jazz it up with Sarto!

event.title: Brunch with Sarto
event.description:
Enjoy a full brunch menu packed with playful, elevated dishes. Offering appetizers like our “Italian Pop-Tart” (Caprese-style in puff pastry), Italian Poutine loaded with short rib and fontina cheese sauce, and the crowd-favorite Avocado Toast on toasted focaccia.

For entrées, the culinary team at Sarto has created modern Italian brunch offerings such as Eggs in Purgatory (poached eggs in fra diavolo sauce with grated gran padano and aleppo pepper, served with focaccia), the Nutella Crespella with strawberries and vanilla soil, and savory stars like the Steak Hash.

Pair it all with our specialty brunch cocktail menu, featuring Bottomless Mimosas, Bottomless Bellinis, and more!

Celebrate Sunday Funday with Brunch at Sarto, for a culinary brunch experience unlike any other in Providence!
